naics.title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)

one_line: Trains frontier AI models and sells access to them, by the token or the seat.
sells: Model access (API), chat apps, coding agents, enterprise subscriptions
customers: Businesses building on AI, developers, consumers
suppliers: Cloud computing, AI chips, data, research talent

revenue.metric: combined annualized revenue of Anthropic (~$81B) and OpenAI (~$70B)
revenue.note: A run rate annualizes the latest month. Excludes Google, Meta and others, so the real total is higher. OpenAI figure is an anonymous-source report.

structure.why: Two labs take 86% of business spending on model APIs (Menlo Ventures, Nov 2026).
structure.hhi_note: From Menlo's enterprise API spend shares. Menlo Ventures is an investor in Anthropic.

econ: High fixed cost, low marginal cost: training a frontier model is a huge one-time cost, while serving one more request is cheap, so the winners are whoever spreads the fixed cost over the most customers.
